name: requirements-check
description: Check the dependency files of a Python web application for supply-chain and reproducibility risks: unpinned requirements, missing or weak hashes, git, URL and local sources, http indexes, extra indexes, duplicate and conflicting pins, and a lock file out of step with the requirements. Reads pip requirements files, uv.lock and poetry.lock; never runs pip, no dependencies.
